HIGH COURT
JUDGES (TRAVELLING ALLOWANCE) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2006
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 13th June, 2006]
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the
High Court Judges (Travelling Allowance) (Amendment) Order, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first day of July, 2005.

Amendment of paragraph 7, P.O. No.4 of 1965

President's Order 2 Of 2006
President's
Order 2 Of 2006
HIGH COURT
JUDGES (TRAVELLING ALLOWANCE) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2006
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 13th June, 2006]
2. Amendment of paragraph
7, P.O. No.4 of 1965.--In the High Court Judges (Travelling
Allowance) Order, 1965 (P.O. No.4 of 1965), hereinafter referred to as the said
Order, in paragraph 7, for the words "three rupees and fifty paisa"
the words "six rupees" shall be substituted.
